blocks.title: First electron affinity
blocks.text: First electron affinity woh enthalpy change hai jo tab hoti hai jab gaseous atoms ke 1 mole mein electrons ka 1 mole shamil ho kar standard conditions par 1 mole gaseous uni-negative ions (ek negative charge wale ions) banaye.

blocks.text_alt: Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻    ΔH = –348.8 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Chunke is mein energy bahar nikalti hai, is liye first electron affinity ka sign negative hota hai.
Note: Electron affinity ki detail (tafseel) chapter 1 mein di gai hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Oxygen, barium aur bromine ki enthalpy change of atomization ki equations state symbols ke saath likhein.
blocks.explanation: Oxygen: ½O₂(g) → O(g). Barium: Ba(s) → Ba(g). Bromine: ½Br₂(l) → Br(g). Har equation mein element apni standard state se gaseous atoms ka ek mole banata hai.

blocks.prompt: b) In reactions ki enthalpy change ki type batayein: (i) C(graphite) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g) (ii) HCl(g) + NH₃(g) → NH₄Cl(s) (iii) H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → H₂O(l)
blocks.explanation: (i) Ek mole carbon ka poora jalna aur saath hi CO₂ ka elements se banna: enthalpy change of combustion (aur formation bhi). (ii) Do gases mil kar ek compound banati hain: enthalpy change of reaction. (iii) Ek mole H₂ ka jalna aur ek mole pani ka elements se banna: combustion aur formation dono.

blocks.prompt: c) Sulfur ki first electron affinity –200 kJ mol⁻¹ aur second electron affinity +640 kJ mol⁻¹ hai. S(g) + 2e⁻ → S²⁻(g) ki enthalpy change nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Dono steps jama karein: –200 + 640 = +440 kJ mol⁻¹. Doosra electron pehle se negative ion par zabardasti dalna parta hai (manfi charge use dhakelta hai), is liye energy absorb hoti hai aur second electron affinity positive hai.

items: First electron affinity: gaseous atoms ka ek mole electrons ka ek mole le kar gaseous uni-negative ions banata hai; energy nikalti hai is liye negative (Cl: –348.8 kJ mol⁻¹); second electron affinity positive hoti hai.
